title: Xenon's WolfSpeed
layout_order: floater (340 x 520, min 300 x 440, resizable) drawn bottom up: region owner's row HERE: ON/OFF, -, MOST HERE <cap>, +, SAVE with 'REGION SETTINGS (you manage this region)' above it (owners only) | message panel (level bar, word, text, x) | OFF (full width) | WALK RUN FAST SUPER | title strip XENON'S WOLFSPEED with THEME at the right | the dial in what is left

controls.label: no control under the pointer: the floater's own handling (drag, resize, close)

speed dial 1x-6x: ticks every 0.5, figures 1-6, lit arc, needle (eased), red hatched LIMIT / OFF HERE zone past the region's most; centre readout <n>x, ON / OFF / PAUSED, 'run about <n> km/h - fly about <n> km/h', '--' when not available
controls.tip: Drag or click the dial to pick a speed (up to what this region allows). Keys: left / right.
controls.action: drag; on release WolfSpeed::request(dialValueAt(x, y)) (never past maxHere)
source: "Drag or click the dial to pick a speed (up to what this region allows). Keys: left / right."
WolfSpeed::instance().request(dialValueAt(x, y));   // sent on release, not while dragging
llformat("run about %d km/h  -  fly about %d km/h"

controls.label: WALK / 1.5x
controls.when: always; disabled when over the region's most or not available; lit when in force

controls.label: RUN / 2x
FAST / 3x
SUPER / <the region's most>x
controls.when: always; disabled when the region's most is 1x
controls.tip: Super: the most this region allows (key 4)
source: case H_WALK: case H_RUN: case H_FAST: case H_SUPER:

controls.label: OFF / normal speed (full width)
controls.tip: Off: back to your normal speed (key 0)
source: case '0': case KEY_BACKSPACE: press(H_OFF); return true;

controls.label: THEME: NIGHT / EMBER / WOLF
controls.tip: Change the look of this window

controls.label: x on the message panel
HERE: ON / HERE: OFF

controls.name: title
controls.label: XENON'S WOLFSPEED (title strip) and floater title Xenon's WolfSpeed

controls.name: message-state
controls.label: with no event: WAIT Asking this region about Xenon's WolfSpeed... / NOT HERE This region does not offer Xenon's WolfSpeed yet. Pick a speed, or press Off.
source: m.mText = "This region does not offer " + FEATURE_NAME + " yet. It comes with the region's next restart.";
m.mText = "The owner of this region has switched " + FEATURE_NAME + " off here.";
m.mText = "This region allows up to " + times(ws.maxHere()) + ". Pick a speed, or press Off.";

controls.name: message-events
controls.label: event messages (stay until dismissed or replaced; some open the window quietly): NO ANSWER, OFF (went off with the login / teleport), ON / PAUSED, LIMIT, NOT HERE, OFF (reset), SAVED, NO ENTRY, WAIT, ERROR; bar red/amber/green/accent + word
source: say(M_WARN, "NO ANSWER", "The region did not answer. Try again in a moment.", true);
+ ". Pick a speed to go fast again.", false);

controls.name: keys
controls.label: Left/Down: half a step slower; Right/Up: half a step faster (to the region's most); 1 Walk, 2 Run, 3 Fast, 4 Super, 0/Backspace Off; only with no modifier and the floater focused
controls.when: floater focused (opened by the person takes focus; opened for a message does not)
source: setFocus(true);   // opened by the person: the arrow and number keys work at once

controls.name: press-release
controls.label: a button acts on release over the same button; capture keeps it from sticking; capture lost cancels drag and press
source: gFocusMgr.setMouseCapture(this);   // the release comes here even off the button, so it never sticks "pressed"
// hidden, or the capture taken away: no drag or press left half done (nothing is sent)
